competitorStrategies.detail: Justin Havre operates justinhavre.com AND calgaryhomes.ca + calgary.com, capturing rankings with multiple properties. 2,500+ pages with dedicated silos for every property type, neighborhood, and surrounding community.

Extensive blog targeting informational keywords (market reports, neighborhood guides, relocation content, first-time buyer resources). Blog posts rank for 'Calgary real estate forecast,' 'best neighborhoods Calgary,' and 'Calgary first time home buyer.'
calgaryhousefinder.ca leverages a keyword-rich domain with hierarchical URL structure (/calgary-nw/tuscany/) and multi-language support (Chinese, French, Korean) to dominate NW Calgary searches.
Reeves & Associates displays 180+ 5-star Google reviews with AggregateRating schema. Combined with monthly market update videos, this builds trust signals Google rewards.

JD Real Estate targets high-intent long-tail keywords ('Investment Property Calgary 2026,' 'Best Schools in Calgary,' 'Cost of Living 2026') with deep educational content that positions the agent as a financial advisor, not just a realtor.

Top competitors go beyond basic contact forms: Justin Havre offers 'Guaranteed Sold' programs and 'Cash Offer' funnels; Reeves uses RealScout property alerts and 'Coming Soon' waitlists; CalgaryHouseFinder forces IDX registration.
